brief: Goldman's daily colour: US equities reached fresh ATHs (SPX +58bps to 7818, NDX +48bps to 31,224) even as RTY fell 59bps, driven by clean investor positioning (hedge fund nets near 5-year lows, GS Sentiment near multi-year lows), covering of macro hedges, and dollar concentration into Tech/AI, which pushed market breadth to its lowest since 2000. Within the tape, HDD weakness (STX, WDC) on competition concerns spread to semicap names, and biotech fell on AVBP's clinical miss; momentum and value led, quality lagged. Consensus S&P 500 Q3 EPS growth is 27% y/y, down from Q2's 33% (ex-distortions), with AI infrastructure beneficiaries driving over half of that growth alongside 116% hyperscaler capex growth. Single-name calls: Reckitt upgraded to Buy on accelerating core growth and margin expansion; Adyen kept Conviction Buy despite a price-target cut to EUR1750 on valuation dislocation; Eurofins raised to EUR89 on margin upside; Hensoldt initiated on backlog visibility against a premium valuation; luxury initiated Buy on Richemont/LVMH/Moncler/Prada and Sell on Hermès into a seen 2027 turning point; Ferrovial's post-I-24 selloff (-17%) called overdone even though financial clarity waits until mid-2027; e-commerce preview stays Buy AMZN/CHEWY/PATTERN over Groupon on resilient but increasingly affluent-skewed consumer spending.
